maya: Quick heads-up — after the kernel-selector patch merged yesterday we're seeing 10-30% tail latency spikes on 8xA100 pipeline runs. Not steady, happens under medium QPS.

jonas: Which part of the pipeline? PP bubble or staging? any flamegraphs?

maya: Appears during stage handoffs (near stage 3->4). I grabbed a short perf dump, main anomaly is heavy all-reduce wait during what should be compute-heavy windows.

maya: ```
# simplified perf sample (avg over 30s)
stage0 compute  45ms
stage1 compute  47ms
stage2 compute  49ms
stage3 compute  12ms
allreduce wait  70ms  <-- spike here
stage4 compute  50ms
# kv-cache hit ratio: 0.82
# microbatch config: global_batch=128, microbatches=16, seq_len=2048
```

lee: kv-hit 0.82 is fine. Could be a kernel fallback on matmul that adds extra sync. Did kernel selector change the preferred GEMM path?

ana: (cc @jonas) also checking batching heuristics: with 16 microbatches we might be leaving compute windows too small for overlap. 1F1B should hide some of this but only if comm/compute alignment is right.

jonas: I instrumented all-reduce fusion thresholds. After kernel-selector flip, the runtime started using the slow fused-allreduce path for 700KB collective sizes. I ran a quick sweep lowering fusion threshold from 256KB->96KB and overlap improved. Numbers:

jonas: ```
before: p50=24ms p95=87ms allreduce_avg=72ms overlap_util=0.43
after (fusion=96KB): p50=22ms p95=58ms allreduce_avg=40ms overlap_util=0.72
```

ci-bot: deploy job 3492 started by jonas (patch: cr/pp-allreduce-fusion-tune)

maya: Nice. Can you drop the experiment config? want to replicate across 2 different hardware tiers (A100-v5 and H100).

jonas: Experiment command: `./run_perf.sh --pp --gpus 8 --microbatches 16 --fusion-threshold 96KB --kernel-debug=on`  Flamegraph/trace saved to s3://perf/1938765432/trace.html

lee: Kernel debug shows the selector falling back to cuBLAS algo 7 on device 3 only. That fallback adds a blocking sync in our runtime path (we forgot to mark it async-safe). So allreduce waits get bunched.

ana: Two mitigations: 1) force preferred kernel family for matmul on the 1F1B hot path until we rework selector; 2) adjust microbatching to 8 microbatches (larger per-microbatch compute) and reduce fusion threshold slightly, which spreads the collectives more evenly.

maya: I ran the 8-microbatch variant on A100-v5. Numbers look promising: p95 down ~18%, allreduce_avg down ~28%. Will run H100 next.

jonas: If we force the kernel family, add a runtime flag `--kernel-override=gemm_fast` and a hotfix in kernel_selector to skip the fallback on pipeline-critical layers. Add a fast fail metric so CI can surface it.

lee: Also let's add a tiny experiment to probe kv-cache warm effects: run same workload with cold cache and with persistent cache to confirm it's not masking something.

maya: Good call. Cold cache run for A100 shows small additional latency (~4ms) but the big deltas still trace to allreduce sync bunched by the kernel fallback.

ana: Plan: (1) revert selector fallback on pipeline-critical layers for next canary, (2) land fusion-threshold tweak behind flag, (3) run 8 vs 16 microbatch sweep across A100/H100, (4) add kernel debug trace to nightly perf job.

jonas: I'll open a PR with the fusion tweak + metric + run-book notes. Will include the `--kernel-override` option.

maya: Thanks — I'll coordinate canaries and post results here. If we see regressions after the rollback we can roll-forward with the safer fusion setting.

lee: sounds good. :thumbsup:

jonas: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5613 (draft)

ci-bot: deploy job 3492 succeeded (canary)

maya: Canary on A100-v5 passed (p95 improved). Scheduling H100 run now.

ana: great. keep notes in the perf-runbook doc and tag me on the PR for sign-off.

maya: Will do. Ending thread — will paste final numbers once H100 finishes.
